title: The Current State of AI Bias Bounties: An Overview of Existing Programmes and Research

bias_targets.methodology: Survey of bias bounty programmes, specifically Twitter's image cropping challenge and Bias Buccaneers' synthetic face labelling challenge, which evaluated performance across skin tones and racial identities.

Survey of bias bounty programmes, including Twitter's image cropping challenge, Bias Buccaneers' gender labelling challenge, and the DoD's LLM challenge which tested for stereotypes against women (e.g., pregnant women, female officers).
Survey of bias bounty programmes, specifically the Bias Buccaneers' age group labelling challenge and the DoD's LLM challenge targeting protected classes including age.
Survey of bias bounty programmes and academic literature, covering the DoD's LLM challenge and a participatory workshop on queer perspectives in AI bias bounties.
Survey of bias bounty programmes, specifically Humane Intelligence's challenges regarding political misinformation and hateful image-based propaganda from far-right extremist groups.
Survey of bias bounty programmes, specifically Humane Intelligence's challenge regarding economic misinformation and fairness in tree planting site recommendations.
